name: Taped Off TV
description: Whole evenings recorded off the air between 1975 and 1999, exactly as they aired: the shows, the network promos, the station IDs and every original commercial. ABC prime time nights, the CBS Late Movie, TGIF, USA's Up All Night, TV-movie premieres and the 1994 USA airing of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Saturday mornings at 7 play real network cartoon blocks, cereal ads and all.
curated: 2026-10-15: VHS and Betamax off-air recordings tagged WOC / with commercials, 1975–1999; music-video channels and partial clips left out; the tapes carry their own commercials, so no extra breaks.
